title: Predictive CPV Analytics for Tablet Compression: XGBoost Prediction, SHAP Explainability, and Applicability-Domain Control
description: Synthetic proof-of-concept for predictive continued process verification (CPV) analytics in tablet compression using lot-aware validation, tuned XGBoost, SHAP explainability, and an applicability-domain control. The package contains 720 synthetic batches across 18 API lots. On the independent unseen-lot synthetic test set, tuned XGBoost achieved MAE 0.602, RMSE 0.740, and R² 0.646. All data are synthetic; the model is not validated for GMP release, batch disposition, autonomous process control, or replacement of laboratory testing.
